main.subtitle.pc: Keyboard, mouse, and media playback count as use
main.help.sync: 1. Pair your phone and computer to track time across both screens. Overlapping periods are counted once, though small errors may remain.
main.help.autoStart: 2. Tracking starts automatically a few seconds after you use the phone. If it does not start, tap “Start” in the top right.
reminder.title: Reminder Time

Repeat reminders (show a reminder each time the limit is reached;
this may happen multiple times a day)

pair.android.title: Pair Phone
pair.android.instruction: First click “Pair Phone” on your computer, then enter the 6-digit code below. Your phone will find the computer automatically; enter the address manually only if it cannot.
pair.android.searching: Looking for your computer on the same Wi-Fi…
pair.android.manualQuestion: Can't find the computer? Enter it manually
pair.android.manualHint: Enter the computer IP address, then tap Connect Manually.

pair.android.failedShort: Pairing failed. Check the code and computer status.
pair.android.notFound: Still looking for your computer. Make sure the Pair Phone window is open on the computer.
pair.android.found: Computer found. Waiting for the computer to confirm the code…
pair.android.manualFallback: Could not connect automatically. You can enter the computer IP address manually and try again.
disconnect.title: Disconnect

disconnect.pcMessage:
After disconnecting, phone and computer sync will stop.
Pair again to reconnect next time.
reminder.channelDescription: Reminds you to rest when screen time reaches your limit
tray.pairWaitingBody: Waiting for your phone to connect. The code is valid for 5 minutes.
